AVAILABLE TODAY

Show your $AUVEN balance with a signed proof.

AUVEN checks the $AUVEN balance in your linked wallet and creates a signed proof for an agent in your workspace. The proof shows what the wallet held at the time of the check.

HOW THE HOLDER PROOF WORKS

Connect. Check. Prove.

Your tokens stay in your wallet. AUVEN only reads the balance; creating a proof does not move or lock any tokens.

01
◇

Connect your wallet.

Sign in and link the wallet that holds $AUVEN. You can only create a proof from a wallet linked to your account.

02
⌁

Check your tokens.

AUVEN reads your $AUVEN balance from the token contract on Robinhood Chain. You need to hold some $AUVEN to continue.

03
▧

Create the proof.

Choose one of your registered agents. AUVEN signs a record of your wallet, balance, and chain block with its post-quantum signing key. You can export it from Proofs.

$AUVEN IN THE PRODUCT

What works now. What comes next.

Only holder proofs are live. The other uses below are planned. Holding $AUVEN does not currently give extra usage, and AUVEN does not yet accept it as payment.

01 / HOLDER PROOFLIVE

Show what you hold.

Create a signed record of the $AUVEN in your linked wallet and attach it to your agent.

Linked wallet → balance check → agent proof
02 / HOLDER BENEFITSPLANNED

Higher limits for your agents.

We plan to give eligible token holders higher request limits for connected agents. We'll publish how much to hold and what you receive before this goes live.

Token holding → eligibility → higher limits
03 / TOKEN PAYMENTSPLANNED

Pay for AUVEN services.

We plan to let you pay for selected services with $AUVEN. We'll show the price and payment terms before you make a payment.

Choose a service → see the price → pay
BUYBACK AND BURN / PLANNED

Use service revenue to buy and burn $AUVEN.

We plan to use a defined share of revenue from AUVEN services to buy $AUVEN and then burn the purchased tokens. A burn removes those tokens from circulation. We'll publish the revenue share, timing, and onchain records before this begins. AUVEN is not running buybacks or burns today.

AUVEN service revenue→Buy $AUVEN→Burn purchased tokens
POST-QUANTUM PROOF

A record you can
check yourself.

Each holder proof is signed with ML-DSA-65, a post-quantum signature. You can export and verify it outside AUVEN. If you choose to publish it, AUVEN also records a proof commitment on Robinhood Chain mainnet.
